# Ecstasy Technologies

Ecstasy Technologies is a software development company founded in 2018 and
based in Bibiani, Ghana. We design and build custom web applications, mobile
apps, hotel management systems, e-commerce platforms, GIS solutions, and
enterprise software for businesses across Ghana and Africa.

## Services

- Web design & development
- Web applications
- Mobile app development (iOS and Android)
- Business / enterprise software
- Hotel management systems (booking, inventory, staff management)
- E-commerce development
- GIS solutions
- UI/UX design

## Who we serve

Hotels, logistics companies, schools, banks, real estate firms, and
enterprise clients across Ghana — including Accra, Kumasi, and Bibiani —
and internationally. We have delivered 32+ projects since founding.

- Founded: 2018
- Location: Bibiani Anhwiaso Bekwai Municipal Assembly, P.O. Box 49, Bibiani, Ghana
